item.title: Knife Terminal 1.4.44
item.description:
• Fix — project descriptions in the sidebar no longer relaunch Claude in a loop. On a connection-limited network such as hotel Wi-Fi, that loop could get the Mac throttled.
  • Photos from the phone — pick photos in the iPhone app and send them into any tab; in a Claude tab they attach as images.
  • Multi-agent tabs — run several coding agents in one tab. They can debate a prompt down to one answer or split the work between them.
  • Agent sign-in per tab — choose the shell default, a plan sign-in, or an API key kept in the Keychain.
